public_rationale: The claim says Bing gave mixed answers about copyright, trademark, originality, and usage rights across several chats Katie Conrad ran in early January 2024. The only records are screenshots in the authors' own post and a later post by Conrad herself. Under the rules, the speaker's own writing cannot count as proof. Searches found no news report, archive, or Microsoft statement documenting these replies. Nothing contradicts the account either. Inconsistent chatbot answers are plausible, but this claim cannot be independently verified.
limitations: Chat outputs are not reproducible, and the product has since been rebranded and changed.
The screenshot content in the post could not be read as text.
